Hi team —

Following up from the product demo last week, MedNova wants a clear MAP and evaluation cadence so procurement and legal can lock the contract window. I put together an initial milestone table (attached) that shows which documents must land before order form signature and which items can be post-signature onboarding tasks. High-level asks:

- Naomi: can you confirm which clauses in the MSA we need settled before procurement will route to finance (termination, data residency, indemnity)?
- Marissa: confirm the commercial open items (discounting, billing cadence) so we can reflect them in the order form draft.
- Jordan: please confirm any internal review gates (procurement review board date, security questionnaire cutoffs) and the preferred DocuSign workflow.

Attached: mednova-MAP-v2.xlsx — two tabs: MAP (milestones + owners) and Eval Plan (test datasets, success criteria). I propose a two-week parallel eval window starting Dec 6, with legal sign-off targeted by Dec 20 to meet a Jan 3 go-live target.

If we can get legal comments by Thursday EOD (Nov 26), I’ll update the MAP and circulate a consolidated tracker to MedNova procurement.

Thanks,
Connor O'Brien
Senior Solutions Manager

Connor —

Thanks for the clear MAP. Quick responses and framing from legal:

1) Pre-signature must-haves (legal):
   - Finalized MSA with data processing appendix (DPA) redlines accepted OR an explicit statement that DPA terms will be executed as an addendum within 30 days of signature.
   - Jurisdiction & venue settled (MedNova requested EU processing carve-outs in the demo; need specifics).
   - Security attachments: SOC 2 Type II report availability or a timeline for delivery.

2) Post-signature acceptable items (we can push these to order-form attachment or onboarding):
   - IP exhibit clarifications that don't affect liability caps.
   - Non-prod environment provisioning schedule.

I'll attach a legal checklist (PDF) that maps to your MAP and marks the items that require explicit MSA language vs. those that can be tactical. If procurement needs the DPA executed before procurement board approval, call that out — it will push the legal gating earlier.

Notes/Questions:
- On data residency: if MedNova insists on EU-only processing for PHI-like datasets, we'll need to confirm deployment mode (dedicated vs private). That impacts order form SKU and timeline.
- Please confirm if the eval will include PII/PHI samples; that drives evidence requests we must include in the MAP.

Naomi Feldman
Lead Counsel, Contracts & Privacy
Redwood Inference

Connor / Naomi / Marissa —

Appreciate the draft MAP. A few items from procurement side:

- Procurement review board meets every second Tuesday; the next slot is Dec 1. To hit your Dec 20 legal sign-off, we need executed DPA + final order-form pricing by Dec 1 to route to finance in the same cycle.
- Our procurement team prefers a single DocuSign envelope for MSA + Order Form, with the DPA as an attachment. If legal requires sequential signatures, flag it now — that will delay routing.
- Security evidence: SOC 2 cert is ideal; if you can provide a current assessment and an attestation letter, that will suffice to start the procurement thread.

Evaluation specifics: we can run the two-week eval window starting Dec 6 as proposed. We will include a technical SME (Anna Park) on Dec 7 for the integration test. Note: our eval data will include de-identified PHI; procurement will need confirmation from Naomi on permitted processing.

I’ll share our internal procurement checklist (short) and a single point of contact for finance approvals: procure@mednova.com.

Jordan Lee
